input.text: Personal bankers may waive service fees up to $25 per account in a calendar year. With branch manager approval noted in the account they may waive up to $50.
sources: Personal bankers may waive service fees up to $25 per account in a calendar year, or up to $50 with branch manager approval noted in the account.

input.text: Each account may receive no more than two fee waivers in a calendar year.
sources: Each account may receive no more than two fee waivers in a calendar year.

input.text: Check deposits over $6,000 in one day are eligible for an extended hold on the amount over that figure.
sources: Check deposits over $6,000 in one day are eligible for an extended hold on the amount over that figure.

input.text: Checks deposited to a new account can be held for as long as 7 business days.
sources: New accounts can have check holds of as long as 7 business days.

input.text: Place a standard hold of 2 business days on deposited checks that do not qualify for next day availability.
sources: Place a standard hold of 2 business days on deposited checks that don't qualify for next-day availability.
